newsitem.title: POLAND: FOREIGN INVESTMENT IN POLAND AT $10.16 BLN IN JULY.
newsitem.headline: FOREIGN INVESTMENT IN POLAND AT $10.16 BLN IN JULY.

text.p: Foreign direct investment in Poland rose to $10.155 billion at the end of July against $6.8 billion in December 1995, the Polish Foreign Investment Agency (PAIZ) said in a statement on Friday.
It said foreign investment in Poland was lead by U.S. companies which have so far invested $2.33 billion and followed by multi-national corporations with $1.47 billion.
Germany came third with investment of $1.34 billion, followed by Italy at $953 million, the Netherlands at $839 million, and France with $657 million.
